title: Chicago ARML
text:
The Chicago ARML team sends several teams each year to compete at the American Regions Mathematics League, a primarily high school mathematics competition.


Chicago ARML team[edit]

The Chicago ARML team consists of four groups of approximately 15 high school students. The four groups are:

  • Chicago A
  • Chicago B
  • Chicago C
  • Chicago JV Team (open to freshmen and sophomores new to ARML)
  • Chicago X A5

Chicago ARML holds a 24 question tryout every year, with the top 30 scorers forming the A/B teams. 30 additional students are selected to form the C/D teams.

The team competes annually at Iowa City site. Chicago ARML has a yearly frisbee game on-site against Minnesota ARML.

Historical Results[edit]

The 2024 Chicago ARML A team was ranked 9th nationally.

The 2023 Chicago ARML A team was ranked 7th nationally.

The 2010 Chicago ARML A team was ranked 15th nationally. The total individual score was a 61 (an average of 4.07/10 per person).

The 2009 Chicago ARML A team was ranked 14th nationally. The total individual score was a 95 (an average of 6.33/10 per person).

The 2008 Chicago ARML A team was ranked 7th nationally, again. The total individual score was a 75 (an average of 5/8 per person), while the team received a perfect score on the team round.

The 2007 Chicago ARML A team was ranked 7th nationally.

The 2006 Chicago ARML A team was ranked 5th nationally.
